---
title: "NeuralFrame Case Events"
---

The table `onc_neuralframe_case_events` contains details about the events recorded for each patient, including radiation, chemotherapy courses, treatments, and any relevant clinical observations.

### Columns Description

##### person_id

OMOP person identifier for the patient.

##### stanford_patient_uid

Internal Stanford tracking ID for NeuralFrame.

##### nfpatientsetid

NeuralFrame patient-set identifier used to group related patient records.

##### nfcaseentityid

Unique identifier for each NeuralFrame case entity.

##### nfpatienteventid

Unique identifier for each NeuralFrame patient event record.

##### eventchemotherapycompletionstatus

Completion status for chemotherapy associated with the event.

##### eventcontactlocation

Coded location where the event contact occurred.

##### eventcontactlocationdescription

Human-readable description of the event contact location code.

##### eventcontactlocationlegacyvendor

Legacy vendor/source value for event contact location.

##### eventcontactperson

Coded role or type of person contacted for the event.

##### eventcontactpersondescription

Human-readable description of the event contact person code.

##### eventcontactpersonlegacyvendor

Legacy vendor/source value for event contact person.

##### eventcoursenumber

Treatment course number associated with the event.

##### eventcoursenumberdescription

Human-readable description of the event course number.

##### eventdiagnosticprocedure

Coded diagnostic procedure captured for the event.

##### eventdiagnosticproceduredescription

Human-readable description of the event diagnostic procedure code.

##### eventnotes

Free-text notes associated with the event.

##### eventothertreatment

Coded value for other treatment related to the event.

##### eventothertreatmentdescription

Human-readable description of the event other-treatment code.

##### eventphasedoseperfraction

Radiation phase dose per fraction for the event.

##### eventphasenumberoffractions

Number of radiation fractions in the event phase.

##### eventphaseradiationdraininglymphnodes

Coded indicator for radiation to draining lymph nodes in the phase.

##### eventphaseradiationdraininglymphnodesdescription

Human-readable description of phase radiation to draining lymph nodes.

##### eventphaseradiationexternalbeamplanningtech

Coded external beam planning technique for the radiation phase.

##### eventphaseradiationexternalbeamplanningtechdescription

Human-readable description of the external beam planning technique code.

##### eventphaseradiationtreatmentmodality

Coded radiation treatment modality for the phase.

##### eventphaseradiationtreatmentmodalitydescription

Human-readable description of the radiation treatment modality code.

##### eventphaseradiationtreatmentvolume

Coded radiation treatment volume for the phase.

##### eventphaseradiationtreatmentvolumedescription

Human-readable description of the radiation treatment volume code.

##### eventphasetotaldose

Total radiation dose delivered in the event phase.

##### eventprotocoleligibilitystatus

Protocol eligibility status recorded for the event.

##### eventprotocolnumber

Protocol or trial number linked to the event.

##### eventprotocolparticipation

Protocol participation indicator or status for the event.

##### eventprotocoltrialtype

Type of protocol or clinical trial associated with the event.

##### eventradiationcompletionstatus

Completion status of radiation treatment for the event.

##### eventradiationphase

Coded radiation phase captured for the event.

##### eventradiationphasedescription

Human-readable description of the radiation phase code.

##### eventrecurrencesite1

Primary coded recurrence site associated with the event.

##### eventrecurrencesite2

Secondary coded recurrence site associated with the event.

##### eventrecurrencesite3

Tertiary coded recurrence site associated with the event.

##### eventrxsummbrm

Event-level code for first-course BRM/immunotherapy summary.

##### eventrxsummbrmdescription

Human-readable description of the event BRM summary code.

##### eventrxsummchemo

Event-level code for first-course chemotherapy summary.

##### eventrxsummchemodescription

Human-readable description of the event chemotherapy summary code.

##### eventrxsummhormone

Event-level code for first-course hormone therapy summary.

##### eventrxsummhormonedescription

Human-readable description of the event hormone summary code.

##### eventrxsummpalliativeproc

Event-level code for first-course palliative procedure summary.

##### eventrxsummpalliativeprocdescription

Human-readable description of the event palliative procedure summary code.

##### eventrxsummscopereglnsur

Event-level code for scope of regional lymph node surgery summary.

##### eventrxsummscopereglnsurdescription

Human-readable description of the event scope-of-node-surgery code.

##### eventrxsummsurgothregdis

Event-level code for surgery of other regional/distant sites summary.

##### eventrxsummsurgothregdisdescription

Human-readable description of the event surgery-other-site summary code.

##### eventrxsummsurgprimsite

Event-level code for surgery of primary site summary.

##### eventrxsummsurgprimsitedescription

Human-readable description of the event surgery-primary-site summary code.

##### eventrxsummsurgprimsite2023

2023 coding version for event surgery of primary site summary.

##### eventrxsummsurgprimsite2023description

Human-readable description of the 2023 surgery-primary-site summary code.

##### eventrxsummsurgicalapproch

Event-level code for surgical approach summary.

##### eventrxsummsurgicalapprochdescription

Human-readable description of the event surgical approach summary code.

##### eventrxsummsurgicalmargins

Event-level code for surgical margins summary.

##### eventrxsummsurgicalmarginsdescription

Human-readable description of the event surgical margins summary code.

##### eventrxsummtransplntendocr

Event-level code for transplant/endocrine procedures summary.

##### eventrxsummtransplntendocrdescription

Human-readable description of the event transplant/endocrine summary code.

##### eventsentinellymphnodesexamined

Number/code indicating sentinel lymph nodes examined for the event.

##### eventsentinellymphnodespositive

Number/code indicating positive sentinel lymph nodes for the event.

##### eventstanfordrouteofadministrationchemo

Stanford-specific route of chemotherapy administration for the event.

##### eventsublocation

Sub-location detail for where the event occurred.

##### eventtype

Coded event type.

##### eventtypedescription

Human-readable description of the event type code.

##### eventtypeofrecurrence

Coded type of recurrence associated with the event.

##### eventtypeofrecurrencedescription

Human-readable description of the recurrence-type code.

##### eventdate

Date of the event.

##### eventdateprotocolended

Date the associated protocol ended for the event.

##### eventrlndate

Date related to regional lymph node activity for the event.

##### eventrxdatesurgicaldisch

Date of surgical discharge associated with the event.

##### eventradiationdateended

Date radiation treatment ended for the event.

##### nfcreatedat

Record creation timestamp in NeuralFrame.

##### nfupdatedat

Record last-update timestamp in NeuralFrame.
